sloka: ते तु तेषां रथाः साश्वाः सह सारथिभिर्हतैः ।महोदरेण निहताः पतिताः पृथिवीतले ।। ७.२३.३९ ॥
transliteration: te tu teṣāṁ rathāḥ sāśvāḥ saha sārathibhirhataiḥ ।mahodareṇa nihatāḥ patitāḥ pṛthivītale ।। 7.23.39 ॥

translations.english: Mahodara struck down their chariots, which, along with their horses and slain charioteers, fell to the ground.
